subject: planner: avoid int range for no PK predicates (#64847)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent. Main behavioral change is in `pkg/planner/core/stats.go` `deriveTablePathStats`: when there are no handle/PK access conditions and the table is not partitioned, it skips `cardinality.GetRowCountByIntColumnRanges` and uses `StatisticTable.RealtimeCount` directly (avoids unnecessary handle full-range stats lookup/trace). No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/consistency/concurrency/privilege/session/runtime handling.
